Caption: A deserted decaying Paris Haussmannian hallway with carved plaster mouldings, cracked beige walls, crooked antique portraits and dusty parquet, a solitary door at the far end. A weak amber wall lamp competes with thin blue light spilling from behind camera, preserving the approved metropolitan thriller aesthetic.
